working_definition_ja: 競走終了後に公表される着順等の情報。
notes: P0-SRC-033 and P0-SRC-035 verify authority-published race results/status; fields and finality rules vary by jurisdiction.

working_definition_ja: 主催者・当局が正式に確定した結果。
notes: P0-SRC-035 explicitly distinguishes official results from unofficial results in USTA status codes.

working_definition_ja: 確定前に公表され、審議・検証等により変更され得る暫定着順・結果。
notes: RES-SRC-001 maps provisional and unofficial result to 暫定着順 before final confirmation; exact finalization process remains jurisdiction-specific.

working_definition_ja: 競走における最終順位。
notes: P0-SRC-037 defines JRA 着順 as the confirmed placing, distinct from order at the line before adjudication.

working_definition_ja: 1着となった馬。
notes: P0-SRC-036 maps winner to 1着馬 in JRA official overseas-racing terminology.

working_definition_ja: 2着となった馬。
notes: RES-SRC-001 directly maps runner-up to 2着馬 in JRA overseas-racing terminology.

working_definition_ja: 複数馬を同順位と判定すること。
notes: P0-SRC-036 verifies dead heat/同着 terminology; RES-SRC-006 verifies DH as a current USTA code. Former duplicate RESULT-028 is retired to this Concept.

working_definition_ja: 僅差の着順を決勝写真等で判定すること。
notes: P0-SRC-039 explains JRA finish-line imaging used by judges to determine order; P0-SRC-036 corroborates photo finish terminology.

working_definition_ja: 競走中の事象について公式に調査・審議すること。
notes: P0-SRC-037 and P0-SRC-038 verify JRA 審議 as formal review of incidents that may affect placings, disqualification or race validity.

working_definition_ja: スチュワードが競走上の事象を調査する審議。
notes: P0-SRC-034 verifies authority Stewards enquiries/reports; procedural scope varies by jurisdiction.

working_definition_ja: 競走・着順・規則違反等について関係者または当局が裁決機関へ正式に申し立てる手続。対象・申立権者は制度により異なる。
notes: RES-SRC-001 maps objection to 走行妨害申立て; RES-SRC-002 confirms current IHRB operational use. Do not equate every jurisdiction's objection/protest procedure.

working_definition_ja: 主に豪州等で、着順・走行妨害等に対して関係者がスチュワードへ申し立てる公式手続。
notes: RES-SRC-003 records a rider-lodged protest against a placing in an official Racing Australia stewards report; procedure remains jurisdiction-specific.

working_definition_ja: 主に北米で、騎手等が競走中の妨害を理由に裁決へ申し立てる手続。
notes: RES-SRC-004 records trainer/jockey claims of foul for interference in an Equibase official chart; decision procedure remains jurisdiction-specific.

working_definition_ja: 規則違反等により馬・騎手・結果等の資格を失わせる裁定。
notes: P0-SRC-038 and P0-SRC-036 verify disqualification/失格; RES-SRC-006/008 support DQ and DISQ as regional display codes. Former duplicate RESULT-027 is retired to this Concept.

working_definition_ja: 審議等により着順を下げる裁定。
notes: P0-SRC-038 and P0-SRC-036 verify demotion/降着 as an adjudicated lowering of placing; do not merge globally with every relegation regime.

working_definition_ja: 主にフランス等で、走行妨害その他の裁定により馬を当初の入線順位より下位へ変更することを指す用語。
notes: EDGE-SRC-004 records France Galop use of relegated for horses moved from first/other placings to lower positions after interference. Preserve Relegation as a regional label/sense rather than globally equating every demotion regime.

working_definition_ja: 競走を有効な結果として扱わない状態・裁定。成立条件や払戻処理は制度により異なる。
notes: RES-SRC-008 verifies VOID as 無効な競走 in current HKJC result presentation; do not generalize the exact voiding consequences globally.

preferred_ja: 不正発走／発走やり直し
working_definition_ja: スターターが適正・安全な発走が成立していないと判断し、競走開始を無効として馬群を呼び戻す・再発走させる状態。具体的な発生条件と再発走手続は管轄で異なる。
notes: EDGE-SRC-003 verifies current 2026 BHA use and review of false starts; BHA starting guidance documents recall/restart procedures. Keep the definition jurisdiction-aware rather than assuming identical global rules.

preferred_ja: ノーコンテスト／勝者なし
working_definition_ja: 主に北米で、裁決により競走を通常の勝敗として成立させず勝者なしとする状態。賭金・賞金処理は規則により異なる。
notes: RES-SRC-005 records No Contest in current ARCI Model Rules Version 14; RES-SRC-006 defines USTA NO CONTEST race status as no winners.

working_definition_ja: 出走したが決勝線まで完走しなかった結果状態。原因の詳細は別の結果コードで表される場合がある。
notes: RES-SRC-008 maps DNF to a horse that did not reach the finish and stopped racing in HKJC results. DNF is stored in the abbreviation layer rather than as the canonical Concept label.

working_definition_ja: 騎手が競走中に馬を止め、完走しなかった結果状態。
notes: RES-SRC-001 maps pull-up to 競走中止; RES-SRC-007 identifies P/PU as pulled up and did not complete the race; RES-SRC-008 corroborates PU in HKJC results.

working_definition_ja: 競走中に馬が転倒し、通常は完走しなかった結果状態。
notes: RES-SRC-007 identifies F as the form abbreviation for a horse that fell. Keep separate from Unseated rider and Brought down.

working_definition_ja: 馬自体の転倒とは別に、競走中に騎手が馬から落ちて完走できなかった結果状態。
notes: RES-SRC-007 maps U/UR to unseated jockey; RES-SRC-008 corroborates UR as a current HKJC result code.

working_definition_ja: 他馬の転倒等に巻き込まれて馬が転倒し、完走できなかった結果状態。
notes: RES-SRC-007 explicitly defines BD as a horse brought down by another runner.

working_definition_ja: Ran Outの結果略号。
notes: Seed code is not present in the current Jockey Club form-code explainer reviewed in this pass; canonical label/code needs authority reconciliation before promotion.

working_definition_ja: 主に障害競走で馬が障害飛越等を拒否し、完走しなかった結果状態。
notes: RES-SRC-007 identifies R as the current form abbreviation for a horse that refused. Former seed label REF is replaced by the semantic Concept and R is stored as its abbreviation.
